items.markingKey: (c) Correct: "Fringe width decreases if the slit separation is increased." The other three are false.
options: Fringe width is independent of wavelength.
Two independent sodium lamps give a stable interference pattern.
Fringe width decreases if the slit separation is increased.
Fringe width increases when the slits are moved apart.

items.stem: Light of wavelength 600 nm in air enters glass of refractive index 1.5. Find its speed, wavelength and frequency in the glass.
items.markingKey: v = c/n = 2.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ (1); λ' = λ/n = 400 nm (1); ν = c/λ = 5.00 × 10¹⁴ Hz, unchanged (1).
